hero-subtitle: Upload a photo of your invoice and let OCR do the dirty work. Edit, confirm and forget. The simplest way to keep your accounts.
how-it-works-subtitle: We have simplified the process to the maximum so that registering an expense does not take more than 10 seconds.
step-1-desc: Upload your invoice from your computer or take a photo directly with your mobile.
step-2-desc: Our OCR system automatically reads the date, the merchant and the total amount for you.
step-3-desc: Check that the data is correct and add it to your history with a single click.
features-desc: Forget about stacks of papers and manual Excels. TrackMyExpenses organizes your expenses by category and offers you a clear view of where your money goes each month.
feature-1: Advanced filters by date and amount
